evals.prompt: Run getitune inference and evaluation on my dataset using a trained PyTorch model, and explain the difference between predict and test.
evals.expected_output: A PyTorch-backed create_engine example that uses test for dataset metrics and predict for per-item outputs.
expectations: Creates an engine with a PyTorch model name or checkpoint and the dataset root
Uses `engine.test()` for aggregate metrics on the test subset
Provides an equivalent `getitune predict` or `getitune test` CLI command with `--data_root` and `--model`

evals.prompt: Run inference with my exported getitune OpenVINO model and explain how I can compare it with the original PyTorch model.
evals.expected_output: An exported-model inference example that passes the OpenVINO XML to create_engine and compares test metrics with the PyTorch baseline.
expectations: Passes the exported OpenVINO `.xml` path as `model=` to `create_engine`
Explains that the exported model is loaded through the OpenVINO backend using ModelAPI
Runs `test()` for metrics and `predict()` for per-item outputs
Compares exported-model metrics with the PyTorch baseline and allows small numerical drift
